slides.title: From Sweden to the world
slides.body:
Sweden's parliamentary ombudsman, *Justitieombudsmannen*, handles complaints about the authorities.

slides.en: She works as a representative at the union.

caption:
Ombudsman is Swedish. Ombud means representative, so an ombudsman is someone who speaks for others.

Sweden set up its parliamentary ombudsman in 1809 to handle complaints about the authorities. Other countries copied the idea and kept the Swedish name.

Did you know this one was Swedish?
